name: CXXGraph
listed_description: free C++(17) graph header-only library for representation and algorithms execution
reason: README comparison against Boost Graph Library is qualitative only (setup time, readability, boilerplate, learning curve; no timings). The repo has Google Benchmark files (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Kruskal and others) that run only as performance-regression checks of CXXGraph against itself in CI; nothing in them or in the README compares against BGL or any other library. The linked results page is on github.io (EGRESS_BLOCKED) but is a github-action-benchmark regression chart. Search found no third-party numbers.

name: dlx
listed_description: Implementation of Knuth's Algorithm X, with example solvers.
reason: README.asciidoc shows only build steps and a usage example; no timings, no comparison against any other exact-cover solver. Search found no third-party benchmark that includes it.

name: docopt.c
listed_description: Implementation of a command-line option parser.
reason: README is usage-only (code generator from docopt help text, options only); no benchmark or timing against getopt, argp or any other parser.

name: ds
reason: README says only that red-black trees use top-down insertion and deletion 'to make it faster' and that memory access may be optimised in future; repo has no benchmark directory and no numbers against any library.

name: EFL
listed_description: Large collection of useful data structures and functions. Various licenses, all open source
reason: The repo carries a benchmark harness (src/benchmarks/eina: hash, array vs list, stringshare, sort, mempool) with comparison code for glib-style, evas and ecore structures, but publishes no results file and no numbers anywhere reachable; README and mirror page have none. enlightenment.org, git.enlightenment.org and docs.tizen.org were EGRESS_BLOCKED, and search snippets showed no figures.
